section.heading: Equitable industrial land use policy.
section.text: The 20-year comprehensive plan submitted to the Council of the District of Columbia in 2027 shall include reforms to the general land use map, the future land use map, elements, and policies targeted at reducing the inequitable concentration of industrial land in District communities.
